about_the_game:
Build, customize, and grow your very own car wash empire!
Auto Washer Life is a realistic car wash simulation that combines intense cleaning mechanics with immersive business management. Wash, manage, drive, and expand—every detail of running a car wash is in your hands.

Start your day by checking supplies, paying bills, preparing your equipment, and setting your service prices. Drive customer vehicles into the wash zone, get hands-on with foam and pressure washers, and deliver a spotless shine. Customize your character, give your shop a unique name, and create a brand customers will remember.

As your business grows, hire employees, upgrade your machines, expand your shop, and improve customer experience. Whether playing solo or in online co-op with up to 4 friends, teamwork and strategy are key to success!

Key Features:

  • Realistic car washing simulation with pressure washers and foam guns

  • Drive vehicles to and from service zones

  • Character customization to make your worker truly yours

  • Name your shop and build a brand identity

  • Business management: hire staff, pay bills, track stock, and set prices

  • Customer feedback system based on performance

  • Equipment and facility upgrades to improve service

  • 4-player online co-op to run the business with friends

  • Daily workflow & financial reports to track your progress

Are you ready to polish your path to success?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580, GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 3.0 Ghz CPU
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT, Geforce RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Run your own car wash business with realistic management and intense cleaning mechanics! Operate pressure washers and foam guns, drive customer cars, hire staff, set prices, manage supplies, upgrade gear, and polish every car to perfection. Go solo or co-op with up to 4 players!
